arguments.value: The Town of Vinton, Virginia renewed Roanoke Gas Company’s franchise to build, operate, maintain, repair, and extend gas distribution lines within the town for 20 years starting January 1, 2016. In return, Roanoke Gas must pay the town a share of a combined franchise fee based on gas sales in Vinton, Roanoke, and Salem, with the total fee increasing 3% annually after 2016. The company must also keep at least one business office in Vinton open at least 40 hours per week, follow nondiscrimination rules, and send notices to the listed addresses.
